note: Link with description subclasses core Link plugins: a field type link_description (extends LinkItem, adds a description text/big column + string property), a widget link_description (core LinkWidget + a 'Long description' textarea), and two formatters link_description (compact, #theme link_with_description) and link_separate_description (separate title/URL, #theme link_with_description_separate_text_url). No settings page (configure=null), no permission, no service, no Drush. Config schema exists for the formatter/widget/field settings. You consume it by adding a field of type link_description to a bundle. Medium reads back which Article field is a link_description field; hard1 adds a link_description field to Article (verified via FieldStorageConfig/FieldConfig); hard2 switches an existing link_description field's default view display to the link_separate_description formatter (verified against the live entity_view_display).

evals.prompt: What field type, widget, and formatter machine names does the Drupal 'Link with description' (link_description) module provide?
evals.expected_output: Field type id link_description (extends core LinkItem), widget id link_description, and two formatters: link_description ('Link with description') and link_separate_description ('Title and link URL with description').

evals.prompt: How does the link_description field type differ from a core Link field in terms of what it stores?
evals.expected_output: It extends core LinkItem and adds a 'description' property backed by a DB column of type text (size big), in addition to the core uri, title and options. Everything else (allowed link type, allow/require link text) is inherited from core Link.

evals.prompt: With the link_description module, which formatter renders the link's title, URL, and description as separate elements rather than a single inline link?
must_contain_any: Title and link URL with description
evals.expected_output: The link_separate_description formatter ('Title and link URL with description'), which extends the core LinkSeparateFormatter and themes output via link_with_description_separate_text_url, producing separate .link-title, .link-url and .link-description elements.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field that uses the link_description module's field type. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_ld_known, a field of type link_description attached to node.article.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a link_description field named field_ld_disp2. Inspect the live default display configuration and state which formatter is used to render that field.
evals.expected_output: field_ld_disp2 is rendered with the link_separate_description formatter ('Title and link URL with description') on node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a new field named field_ld_task to the Article content type using the 'Link with description' (link_description) field type, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a FieldStorageConfig node.field_ld_task of type link_description and a FieldConfig attaching it to the article bundle. Verify passes when the storage is type link_description and the field is on Article.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a link_description field field_ld_disp shown with the compact 'Link with description' formatter. Change the default display so this field renders its title, URL and description as separate elements, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On the node.article.default entity_view_display, set the field_ld_disp component's formatter type to link_separate_description and save. Verify passes when the field still exists and its display formatter is link_separate_description.
